notes: Fixes the reported container traceback: /opt/qwen-tts-deps/transformers/dependency_versions_check.py raises ImportError at transformers import time because it pins huggingface-hub>=0.34.0,<1.0 while the image ships huggingface-hub==1.33.0, and no package installation or network access is allowed. qwen_tts imports transformers (through qwen_tts/inference/qwen3_tts_model.py) before anything in main.py can act, so the fix has to be installed before the first transformers import. main.py now has _install_huggingface_hub_version_shim() which: (1) reads the real value via importlib.metadata.version; (2) if it is outside (>=0.34.0,<1.0), replaces importlib.metadata.version with a wrapper that reports the pinned-compatible string '0.35.0' ONLY for the distribution name 'huggingface-hub' and forwards every other call untouched to the original function; (3) also sets huggingface_hub.__version__ to the reported value for code paths that read the attribute directly; (4) records the real version, the reported version and the pin in HFHUB_STATE. No other package version is altered. This shim is invoked by _install_offline_shims() alongside the previously added sox and pooch shims, and cmd_doctor now calls _install_offline_shims() at its very top (before its `import transformers` line, which previously would have hit the same ImportError) as well as cmd_run and import_qwen_tts, so ordering is enforced on every path. doctor output and run.json now include compatibility.huggingface_hub_version next to compatibility.sox and compatibility.pooch, plus a 'compatibility_huggingface_hub_version' check row; the run still hard-requires CUDA, refuses CPU fallback, refuses missing inputs, loads Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base in bf16 on cuda:0, calls generate_voice_clone with the real input/reference.wav and input/reference_text.txt and x_vector_only_mode=False, validates every waveform as decodable/finite/non-zero before and after PCM-16 write, emits output/speech/<id>.wav, output/index.jsonl, output/run.json and output/rng_state.pt with real GPU-synchronised timings and durations, and never treats a missing-input report as a solved task. No contract changes and no new dependencies.
